tools.name: search_revogrid_docs
tools.description: Use for broad RevoGrid questions or when the exact API name is unknown. Searches source-grounded docs and API evidence; defaults to public exports.

tools.name: find_examples
tools.description: Use when implementation evidence should be a runnable or registered RevoGrid example, optionally filtered by framework and package.

tools.name: resolve_feature_matrix
tools.description: Resolve whether a RevoGrid feature exists, whether it is Pro, and where to learn it.

tools.name: get_migration_notes
tools.description: Get upgrade notes between RevoGrid versions.

tools.name: list_revogrid_capabilities
tools.description: Start here to discover supported public capabilities and package ownership. Returns compact paginated summaries linked to detailed resources.

tools.name: inspect_revogrid_api
tools.description: Use after discovery to resolve one exact symbol or capability. Returns ambiguity candidates instead of guessing and includes its supported import and evidence.

tools.name: plan_revogrid_implementation
tools.description: Use after resolving capability names to compose a deterministic package, plugin-order, configuration, lifecycle, and compatibility blueprint.

tools.name: validate_revogrid_usage
tools.description: Use before implementation handoff to statically check structured RevoGrid imports, configuration, dependencies, versions, and optional bounded source. Never executes code.
